analysis_type: transparent post hoc analysis; not a new experiment or overall preregistration

primary_pair.sparse: native abrupt IMP80 at global step 1000
primary_pair.unpruned: compatible unpruned trajectory from the same reconstructed step-1000 parent

validation.definition: complete native validation population, target-token weighted, including native partial final batch

definitions.D_validation: L(post-prune at global step 1000) - L(pre-prune at global step 1000), on the identical complete validation population
definitions.D_event_probe: L(post-prune) - L(pre-prune) on the original event training-only diagnostic batches; never pooled with validation
definitions.G_seed_condition_offset: L_sparse(seed, condition, offset) - L_unpruned(seed, condition, offset)
definitions.C_seed_condition_offset: D_validation(seed) - G_seed_condition_offset(offset), only when common-parent and evaluation checks pass
definitions.H_seed_condition_offset: G_seed_condition_offset(0) - G_seed_condition_offset(offset); observed initial-gap closure only if common-parent or paired-D requirements fail
definitions.P_R: L_router_frozen - L_full, computed within model type, seed, and offset
definitions.P_E: L_experts_frozen - L_full, computed within model type, seed, and offset
definitions.P_RE: L_router_experts_frozen - L_full, computed within model type, seed, and offset; this is the shared-only branch
definitions.interaction: I = L11 - L10 - L01 + L00; 1 means that component adapts, shared parameters train in every cell
definitions.integral: trapezoidal integral over the observed common offset grid only; no extrapolation

aggregation.primary: show every seed-level value; summarize across five source seeds with mean, median, minimum, maximum, and sample SD
aggregation.confidence_intervals: none added; any interval already present in prior reports is descriptive and seed-level only

checkpoint_only_diagnostics.authorization: checkpoint-only forwards are limited to shared-only pathway diagnostics; no backward pass, optimizer update, training-batch advance, component swap, or state mutation
metrics: final-normalized-hidden representation change on identical input tokens
checkpoint_only_diagnostics.reused_measurements: existing sealed-probe routing, expert-function, input-representation, update, and validation caches

interpretation_limits: C is closure of an observed pruning-associated CE gap, not uniquely attributable repair and not proof original function is restored.
H is only observed initial-gap closure when D or parent requirements are not verified.
A larger sparse loss reduction from a worse starting loss is not by itself evidence for specialized compensation.
Frozen experts remain functionally in the pathway because shared adaptation may change their inputs, gates, assignments, and use.
The tied embedding/output matrix has both input and output roles.
Candidate diagnostics describe processes and are not a causal decomposition.
